blocks.html: The county’s upcoming teen sensation is going to hit south of Manila next weekend. Fans and followers of the 13-year old pop singer Bailey May are in for a treat on April 16, 2016, Saturday, 5:00 pm at Robinsons Place Las Piñas (located along Alabang - Zapote Road and near BF Resort Village, Las Piñas) when he performs his latest hits from self-titled album under Star Music. Watch him as he renders a wide range of songs, hitting notes with his renditions of songs like “Build Me Up, Buttercup”, “Gusto Kita” and “Can You be My Girl?” among others. Get ready to swoon as the Filipino-British teen heartthrob performs these sweet love songs. Fans who purchase Bailey’s album get to see him up close at a meet and greet after the show. His charm, talent and good looks also paved the way to more opportunities and landed him to be one of the cast members of the recently-concluded top rating romantic comedy television series, On the Wings of Love.
